description.narrative: Jordan's digital economy has grown rapidly in recent years, accelerated by COVID-19, and driven by a young, tech-savvy population, high internet penetration, and government policies. The government of Jordan has identified the digital sector as a priority area, recognising its strong potential for growth and job creation. This aligns with the country's broader ambition to position itself as a leading digital hub in the region. Jordan is considered to have a high rate of entrepreneurship initiatives compared to other countries in the region and enjoys the availability of affordable technical talent, geopolitical stability, good infrastructure, a liberalised telecom sector, proximity to key regional markets, and government support.The key challenge for micro-, small- and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in the ICT sector in Jordan is the limited domestic market: the small size of the population and its purchasing power means that Jordan can only achieve scale through exports. At the same time, Jordan has a growing ecosystem of technology startups and SMEs, especially in cities like Amman.This offers opportunities for collaboration with Jordanian companies in areas such as fintech, edtech, healthtech, and other innovative technologies. Dutch companies can consider investing in, source from or forming partnerships with these SMEs, particularly if they are interested in expanding into the broader Middle Eastern region.This mission and assignment for a sector expert assignment is proposed to assist Jordan in the digital transition by establishing connections and create potential business opportunities for Jordanian companies in the IT sector. In order to increase the effectiveness of the mission, it needs to be tailored to the specific needs of the targeted groups of companies, with the aim to strengthen the (trade) relationship between IT sectors in Jordan and the Netherlands/European Union (EU), while at the same time gain more insight in the opportunities for future Dutch programming in the digital transition as this contributes to economic development and creating jobs.
